people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.
translations.bsb: Therefore Jesus told them, “Although your time is always at hand, My time has not yet come.
translations.kjv: Then Jesus said unto them, My time is not yet come: but your time is alway ready.
translations.asv: Jesus therefore saith unto them, My time is not yet come; but your time is always ready.
